ChatRoom.title: ChatRoom
ChatRoom.description: A direct or support real-time chat room between users or customer support.

participants.description: List of user IDs participating in the conversation

participantNames.description: Mapping of user ID to display name

lastMessageText.description: Snippet of the most recent message

supportTopic.description: Optional support category or inquiry context

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the room was created

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual real-time message inside a chat room.

chatId.description: ID of the parent chat room

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent

/chats/{chatId}.description: Collection of direct and support chat conversations.

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Sub-collection of ordered messages inside each chat room.
